limits: Actual normal/macro tiers are observed on the first cage-bound shell through fresh draw callbacks and unique factory topology/UV matches at native-window endpoints. This does not independently verify every organ or uninterrupted tier stability. Nodes must match the exact species/device census and remain equal between the two views.

Native inputs count submitted indices/vertices multiplied by instances; native draws and inputs are divided by qualifying renderer.render boundaries, not whole R3F advances. Shadow/postprocessing passes may affect that denominator. Focused detailed physics does not measure Hoya ambient batching.

Approximate cadence means successful R3F advances per second, not GPU completion, compositor FPS, or a 60-FPS claim. CPU means are app rolling values, not fresh-window medians, and displacement preparation excludes native GPU upload. Optional WebGPU bakes are disabled.

Desktop and iPhone-style mobile emulation run on the same host. The mobile profile is not a physical phone. Background applications, power mode, instrumentation, polling, caches and thermal state are not isolated. Twenty startup observations are repeated across forty rows; do not count forty independent startups.

These forty detailed observations are separate from garden-overview budget validation. The shader-reuse.spec.ts attachment uses a 390×844 viewport in both Chrome and WebKit, hence a constrained layout despite a desktop project label; it does not establish the desktop overview budget. Preserve the attachment's actual viewport and budget when citing it.
Measurement completion is not full browser-suite acceptance. Preserve interrupted and failed-suite evidence independently; do not infer an all-pass sweep from this aggregate.
